name: TabIntel
headline: Duplicate Tab Manager & Tab Search
tagline: Find and clean duplicate tabs, manage all your tabs, and search across your open tabs.
highlights: Instant duplicate detection across all open windows & tab groups
Exact URL vs. Domain level duplicate matching modes
One-click smart clean (retain oldest or newest tab)
Instant omni-search across tab titles, URLs, and favicons

features.title: Smart Duplicate Detection
features.description: Scans across all open windows in milliseconds. Groups tabs by URL or domain so you can reclaim RAM without accidentally closing important work.

features.title: Keyboard-First Omni-Search
features.description: Never hunt for lost documentation again. Open the extension with Ctrl+Shift+E, type a few letters, and jump directly to the target tab.

features.title: Configurable Deduplication Rules
features.description: Choose whether you prefer keeping the earliest created tab or the newest tab when cleaning duplicates, with non-destructive grouping options.

features.title: Private & Air-Gapped Operation
features.description: Does not track, inspect, or transmit your URLs. All processing executes purely in your browser's local memory.

permissions.purpose: Used strictly on-device to inspect open tab URLs and titles for duplicate detection and tab navigation.
Saves your custom matching preferences and cleanup settings locally in Chrome sync storage.

faq.q: Does TabIntel transmit my browsing history or open URLs to external servers?
faq.a: No. TabIntel is strictly local-first. All tab comparisons and searches occur purely inside your Chrome browser memory. No servers, no tracking scripts, no third-party analytics.

faq.q: What happens when I click 'Clean Duplicates'?
faq.a: TabIntel evaluates duplicate pairs and retains either the oldest or newest tab according to your preference, safely closing only the duplicates.

faq.q: Can I use TabIntel across multiple browser windows?
faq.a: Yes! TabIntel scans and aggregates tabs across all active Chrome windows and tab groups.

name: Path Jump
headline: URL Path Navigator & Environment Switcher
tagline: Save URL paths and jump to them instantly on any website or environment.
highlights: Fuzzy path search and quick-launch command palette
Dynamic parameter templating and path bookmarking

features.title: Instant Path Jumping
features.description: Bookmark complex, nested URL routes like /api/v2/webhooks or /settings/team. Jump to them on whatever domain you are currently browsing with a single keypress.

features.title: Environment Transposition
features.description: Easily swap current base domains between local development (http://localhost:3000), staging, and production while preserving exact deep paths and query params.

features.title: Hotkeys & Palette Interface
features.description: Never take your fingers off the keyboard. Press Alt+P (or Option+P) to summon the path palette, hit Enter, and navigate immediately.

features.title: Offline & Security First
features.description: Your internal paths, tokens, and endpoints remain 100% confidential. No telemetry, no cloud synchronization, pure client-side privacy.

permissions.purpose: Used only when triggered by user action to retrieve the current URL and append the chosen navigation path.
Stores your saved path presets and environment mappings locally in your Chrome extension storage.

faq.q: What is the primary use case for Path Jump?
faq.a: Developers, QA engineers, and power users often test or review routes like /dashboard/billing across multiple environments (local, dev, staging, prod). Path Jump lets you jump or swap domains in one keystroke without manually editing the address bar.

faq.q: Does Path Jump read sensitive authentication tokens or headers?
faq.a: No. Path Jump only interacts with the browser's navigation bar URL upon your direct keyboard or click invocation.

faq.q: Can I group paths by project or category?
faq.a: Yes, you can tag and categorize your saved path bookmarks for quick contextual filtering.
